'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2024 Kursk offensive]]
****[[Russia]] declares a "federal-level" emergency in [[Kursk Oblast]] as [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] continue to advance. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/russia-declares-federal-emergency-border-region-attack-ukrainian-112704921 (AP via ABC News)]
****[[Kadyrovites|Akhmat special forces]] commander [[Apti Alaudinov]] says that [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] troops "simply passed-by" their positions without engaging them, with Akhmat troops choosing to [[Withdrawal (military)|retreat]] until more Russian reinforcements could arrive. Other reports indicate that Akhmat troops fled from Ukrainian forces. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/kadyrov-s-troops-claim-they-missed-ukrainian-forces-in-kursk-oblast/ar-AA1otucS (''The New Voice of Ukraine'' via MSN)]
****A Russian military convoy is destroyed on the [[European route E38|E38 highway]] in [[Oktyabrsky District, Kursk Oblast|Oktyabrsky District]].  [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/aug/09/ukraine-ambushes-russian-convoy-in-kursk-as-kremlin-declares-federal-emergency (''The Guardian'')]
****[[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian troops]] capture the [[Gazprom]] gas facility in [[Sudzha]]. A video shows Ukrainian soldiers inside the [[natural gas]] facility, with much of the town reportedly under Ukrainian control. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/08/09/video-shows-ukrainian-soldiers-in-control-of-gas-facility-in-russia-s-kursk-region (Reuters via Al Arabiya)]
***[[Ukraine]] launches a "massive" [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] on [[Lipetsk Oblast]], Russia, with [[Lipetsk air base]] reportedly on fire. Several villages are evacuated, with six people reportedly injured. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-lipetsk-region-comes-under-massive-drone-attack-governor-says-2024-08-09/ (Reuters)]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[2024 Kostiantynivka supermarket missile attack]]
****A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[missile]] attack on a supermarket in [[Kostiantynivka]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], kills 14 people and injures 43 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-killed-17-injured-russian-strike-supermarket-ukraines-east-2024-08-09 (Reuters)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***The [[United States]] announces it will send Ukraine a $125 million [[military aid]] package, including [[FIM-92 Stinger]] missiles, [[Shell (projectile)|artillery ammunition]], and [[Man-portable anti-tank system|anti-armor systems]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/us-send-stinger-missiles-ammunition-ukraine-new-125-million-package-2024-08-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Third Battle of Khan Yunis]]
****[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli troops]] launch a new assault on [[Khan Yunis]], with [[Airstrike|airstrikes]] killing at least 21 [[Palestinian]]s in the city and [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] initiating ground operations in the city for the third time since the war's beginning. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-08-09-2024-585d6a6e9dbe474083d3daec441e340c (AP)]
**[[United States support for Israel in the Gaza war]]
***The United States finances [[Israel]] with $3.5 billion to spend on U.S. weapons and military equipment. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/us-releases-35-billion-israel-spend-us-weapons-military-equipment-cnn-reports-2024-08-09/ (Reuters)]
**[[Samer al-Hajj]], a [[Hamas]] security official for the [[Ain al-Hilweh]] [[Palestinian refugee camps|Palestinian refugee camp]], is [[Assassination|assassinated]] by an [[Israel]]i [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] in [[Sidon]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/9/israel-steps-up-attacks-in-lebanon-kills-hamas-official (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli occupation of the West Bank]]
***The United States declares the [[Netzah Yehuda Battalion]] eligible for US military assistance. The unit is known for establishing illegal outposts on Palestinian land, and was removed from its traditional posting in the [[West Bank]] in 2022 due to [[human rights]] violations against Palestinians. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/9/us-declares-controversial-israeli-battalion-eligible-for-assistance (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Voepass Linhas Aéreas Flight 2283]]
**A [[Voepass Linhas Aéreas]] [[ATR 72-500]] aircraft crashes in [[Vinhedo]], [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]], [[Brazil]], killing all 62 people on board. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-plane-crash-sao-paulo-394427322513643f4eaf517e4ac4c85e (AP)] [https://g1.globo.com/sp/campinas-regiao/noticia/2024/08/09/acidente-aviao-vinhedo.ghtml (G1 Globo)]
*Nine people are killed and 26 others injured after a bus crash in [[Polatlı]], [[Turkey]]. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-bus-crash-polatli-f6dd6eb6c8a7400a939d70084c2f8777 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Sierra Leone coup attempt]]
**A [[military court]] in [[Sierra Leone]] sentences 24 [[Republic of Sierra Leone Armed Forces|soldiers]] to prison terms ranging from 50 to 120 years for their roles in a failed [[coup]] attempt in November 2023. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sierra-leone-court-sentences-soldiers-long-jail-terms-failed-coup-2024-08-10/ (Reuters)]
*Prosecutors in [[China]] charge multiple funeral directors with selling more than 4,000 corpses to two major medical companies over several decades. Police seized 18 tonnes of bones and 34,000 semi-finished products, with the thieves having earned around 380 million [[Chinese yuan|yuan]] ([[United States dollar|US]]$53 million) before they were arrested. [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3273761/chinese-crime-ring-accused-stealing-thousands-corpses-use-bones-dental-grafts (SCMP)] [https://nos.nl/artikel/2532521-lijkenschandaal-in-china-duizenden-lichamen-verkocht-aan-medische-sector (NOS)] [https://www.newsweek.com/china-thousands-corpses-smuggled-bone-graft-medical-health-scandal-1936276 (''Newsweek'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Mali]], [[Foreign relations of Sweden]], [[Mali–Russia relations]]
**[[Mali]] orders the [[List of ambassadors of Sweden to Mali|Swedish ambassador]] to leave within 72 hours, days after [[Sweden]] announced that development aid to Mali would be suspended over Mali's support for [[Russia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/9/mali-orders-swedish-ambassador-to-leave-within-72-hours (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.government.se/statements/2024/08/statement-by-foreign-minister-tobias-billstrom/ (Swedish Foreign Ministry)]
*[[Saudi Arabia–United States relations]]
**The [[Biden administration]] partially lifts a three-year-old ban on American [[arms industry|weapons sales]] to [[Saudi Arabia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-lift-ban-offensive-weapons-sales-saudi-arabia-sources-say-2024-08-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Venezuelan presidential election]]
**[[President of Venezuela| Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] suspends the [[Twitter|X]] social network in [[Venezuela]] for 10 days, accusing X's owner [[Elon Musk]] of promoting hatred. [https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-elections-suspension-x-elon-musk-59bb734bdd0c8cc4082d6a0cb0f5af25 (AP)]
*[[2024 Vienna terrorism plot]]
**The [[Austria]]n [[Ministry of the Interior (Austria)|interior minister]] announces the arrest of an [[Iraq]]i man in connection with a foiled terror attack at [[United States|American]] singer [[Taylor Swift]]'s [[The Eras Tour|concerts]] in [[Vienna]], which were cancelled in response to the attack. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/aug/09/teenager-arrested-foiled-taylor-swift-concert-attack-vienna (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Hundreds of people protest in [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]], against violence targeting the country's [[Hinduism in Bangladesh|Hindu minority]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/hundreds-protest-dhaka-over-violence-against-hindus-bangladesh-2024-08-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Summer Olympics]]
**[[Algeria at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Imane Khelif]] wins the gold medal in the [[Boxing at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's 66 kg|Women's 66 kg]] [[Boxing at the 2024 Summer Olympics|boxing]] event, after facing controversy and harassment related to a 2023 gender evaluation by the [[International Boxing Association]], which is no longer recognized by the [[IOC]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2024/8/9/algerias-imane-khelif-beats-yang-liu-to-win-boxing-gold-at-paris-olympics (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Breaking at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***In the first-ever [[breakdancing]] event at the Olympics, [[Ami Yuasa]] of [[Japan at the 2024 Summer Olympics|Japan]] wins the [[Breaking at the 2024 Summer Olympics – B-Girls|B-Girls]] gold medal, with [[Dominika Banevič|Dominika "Nicka" Banevič]] of [[Lithuania at the 2024 Summer Olympics|Lithuania]] winning the silver and [[Liu Qingyi|Liu "671" Qingyi]] of [[China at the 2024 Summer Olympics|China]] winning the bronze. [https://apnews.com/article/2024-olympics-breaking-aea17bcb4ec9ad60ea7222d4b608a05d (AP)]
**[[Concerns and controversies at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[French police]] arrest [[Egypt]]ian wrestler [[Mohamed Ibrahim El-Sayed]] for allegedly [[groping]] a woman at a café. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/olympics/articles/c8dpmrrj6ggo (BBC News)]
